blocks.title: Locked in for 28 June
blocks.text: A Rookie Showcase is set for 28 June, giving newer players a competitive event against others at a similar level while also putting them in front of league members and team staff.
The event is designed to help rookies and newer players show what they can do, while also helping assess whether a Division 2 league is viable.

blocks.title: How it works
items: Accepted applicants will be placed into a draft pool.
Coaches will build teams through a snake draft.
Teams will then play in a round robin tournament.

blocks.title: Eligibility
items: Players should have fewer than 5 games in a single league season or fewer than 10 league games in total.
Exceptions can be considered for players who are only slightly outside the guidelines.
If you think an exception applies to you, include that in your application.

blocks.text: If you're interested in joining as a Coach or Mentor, you should fill out the same form as well.
